# FloatRange

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct FloatRange(float Min, float Max)
```

A range of values, sampled uniformly at random; a single value converts to a range of one value.

## Remarks

Write a range as a tuple: `Speed = (100, 300)`, or a single value: `Speed = 200`.

## Constructors

```csharp
public FloatRange(float value)
```

A range of one value: always that.

### Around

```csharp

```

